name: Fetch Pending Documents
description: Fetches documents from the Knowledge Base that need documentation generation. Supports filtering by status (pending, outdated, error) and collection.

inputs.name: Collection
inputs.description: Specific collection to query, or leave empty for all collections

inputs.name: Limit
inputs.description: Maximum number of documents to return

outputs.name: Documents
outputs.description: List of document envelopes matching the criteria

outputs.name: Collections
outputs.description: Unique list of collections that have matching documents

metadata.author: Maestro Team
metadata.overrideInstructions: Clone this block to add custom filtering logic or modify the query parameters.
